title: How Does the Internet Actually Work? (It Runs Under the Ocean)
short_title: Your videos travel under the ocean 🌊 #shorts
description:
Tap a video and, in a fraction of a second, it crosses cities and oceans to reach you. Packets, IP addresses, DNS, routers, undersea cables and pulses of light: here is how the Internet really works, step by step.

{CHAPITRES}

Subscribe to Factora so you never miss a fascinating fact.

Sources: Internet Society (brief history of the Internet, ARPANET 1969); CERN (the birth of the World Wide Web, 1989); IETF RFC 791 (Internet Protocol) and RFC 1034 (Domain Name System); TeleGeography (submarine cable map); Encyclopaedia Britannica (optical fiber, Internet).

Synthetic voice, original illustrations.

#internet #technology #science #howitworks #facts
